sloka: पृथिवीधरसङ्काशो विपीड्य धरणीधरम्।पृथिवीं क्षोभयामास सार्णवां मारुतत्मजः ।। ६.७४.४१ ।।
transliteration: pṛthivīdharasaṅkāśo vipīḍya dharaṇīdharam।pṛthivīṁ kṣobhayāmāsa sārṇavāṁ mārutatmajaḥ ।। 6.74.41 ।।

translations.english: Son of the wind god, who was like a mountain supported by earth, pressing hard caused the earth with its ocean to shake.
